items.titleOriginal: Microsoft expands Azure AI and HPC infrastructure with AMD
items.summaryOriginal: AI workloads are scaling faster than any single infrastructure approach can support — with more models, new agent-driven workloads and surging compute demand driving the need for greater specialization across the stack. To meet this need, Microsoft continues to evolve Azure’s infrastructure, including expanding its AI fleet with AMD’s most advanced AI and high-performance computing... The post Microsoft expands Azure AI and HPC infrastructure with AMD appeared first on The Official Microsoft Blog .

items.titleZh: 微软与 AMD 合作扩展 Azure AI 和 HPC 基础设施
items.titleEn: Microsoft expands Azure AI and HPC infrastructure with AMD
items.summaryZh: 人工智能工作负载的扩展速度比任何单一基础设施方法所能支持的速度都要快——更多的模型、新的代理驱动的工作负载和激增的计算需求推动了整个堆栈更加专业化的需求。为了满足这一需求，微软不断发展 Azure 的基础设施，包括利用 AMD 最先进的 AI 和高性能计算扩展其 AI 机群……微软利用 AMD 扩展 Azure AI 和 HPC 基础设施的帖子首先出现在微软官方博客上。
